correctness.rationale: For \(Q=4^s\) and \(m=(2Q+1)/3\), the monomial differential basis has \(4i+mj\le2Q-4\) and \(j\le2\). The identity \(y=y^Q+\sum_t x^{m4^t}\) shows that the \(Q\)-fold Cartier iterate kills the \(j=0,2\) basis elements and carries exactly \(s\) elements with \(j=1\), at \(i=(Q-4^t-3)/3\), to distinct even-exponent outputs \(x^{2(4^t-1)/3}dx\). One more Cartier application vanishes. Independent exact direct and iterated checks agree for \(n=3,5,7,9,11,13,15\); no finite extrapolation is used in the universal proof.

value.rationale: The formula gives the sharp maximality-based nilpotency threshold and exactly counts the surviving Cartier directions in an entire natural infinite family of maximal curves. The final rank grows like n while the genus grows exponentially. This refines existing a-numbers/p-ranks and supplies a motivated endpoint of the Cartier filtration without an unsupported downstream claim.
